capabilities: Attach labels to individual LaTeX terms
Draw leader lines from each label to its term
Color-code labels with six named colors
Place labels above or below their terms
Typeset labels as plain text or math
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later; wide equations must be scrolled horizontally to see every label.
problem: LaTeX equations in Obsidian cannot point at a single term, so explaining what each symbol means requires prose outside the math block.

relations.evidence: Translate existing TikZ annotations into \annotate commands before pasting.

summary: Code fence that labels individual terms in a LaTeX equation with color-coded text and leader lines.
